conditions: Every targeted opponent must decline (or be unable) to pay Smothering Tithe's {2} tax on every relevant draw, both for the original Smothering Tithe and for Clever Impersonator's copy of it - an opponent choice this deck does not control. If any opponent pays even once, that specific Treasure isn't created and the cycle's income drops by 1 mana for that instance.

Requires at least 3 opponents for the cycle to be strictly mana-positive (income > cost). At exactly 2 opponents (Commander Spellbook's stated minimum prerequisite), the cycle is merely mana-neutral (income == cost) - see result.summary for the exact arithmetic.
name: Faerie Mastermind + Smothering Tithe + Clever Impersonator (copying Smothering Tithe) -> repeatable draw/mana engine

prerequisites.mana_available: {3}{U} per activation of Faerie Mastermind's 'Each player draws a card' ability.
prerequisites.timing: Any time the controller has priority and can pay {3}{U}; the loop's core action is repeatedly activating Faerie Mastermind's own activated ability.
other: EXACT MECHANISM (re-derived from primary Oracle text 2026-08-12, not Commander Spellbook's paraphrase): Faerie Mastermind: '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card.' Smothering Tithe: 'Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player may pay {2}. If the player doesn't, you create a Treasure token.' Clever Impersonator, having entered as a copy of Smothering Tithe, is a second independent Smothering Tithe-functioning permanent (CR 707.2) - so each opponent's single draw from Faerie Mastermind's ability triggers BOTH Tithe-copies independently (two separate objects, each with its own copy of the triggered ability).

PER-CYCLE ARITHMETIC: activating Faerie Mastermind costs {3}{U} = 4 mana flat (no cost reduction in this card set, unlike INT-0005). Each opponent who declines both Tithe triggers yields 2 Treasures (1 base Smothering Tithe + 1 Clever Impersonator copy). With O opponents all declining: income = 2*O Treasures = 2*O mana when each Treasure is tapped+sacrificed (CR 605 mana ability). Net per cycle = 2*O - 4.

At O=2 (Spellbook's stated minimum 'at least two opponents'): net = 4-4 = 0. Mana-NEUTRAL, not infinite/growing mana - the cycle can still be repeated indefinitely for its 'each player draws a card' effect (a real, unbounded value engine: infinite card draw for every player at the table), but it does not bank a growing mana or Treasure surplus at this opponent count. Calling this 'infinite mana'/'near-infinite Treasure tokens' at O=2 would overclaim - see charter guidance against calling a mana-neutral repeatable sequence infinite mana.
At O=3 (a standard 4-player pod): net = 6-4 = +2 per cycle. Genuinely unbounded/growing mana and Treasure count.

Faerie Mastermind's OWN passive trigger ('Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, you draw a card') is NOT a repeating engine within a single turn - it triggers only once per opponent per turn, specifically on their exact second card drawn that turn, not on every subsequent draw. It contributes at most O extra cards to the controller's hand once per turn, separate from (and much smaller than) the repeated-activation loop above. Do not conflate this bounded once-per-turn trigger with the unbounded 'each player draws a card' activated-ability loop.
This is a value/resource engine, not a combo-kill by itself (is_win_condition: false).

result.summary: With exactly 2 opponents (both declining Smothering Tithe + its copy every time): a mana-neutral (net 0) but freely repeatable 'each player draws a card' engine - unbounded card draw for every player at the table, no growing mana/Treasure bank. With 3+ opponents (all declining): net +2 mana and +2 Treasures per cycle, genuinely unbounded accumulating mana in addition to the unbounded draw effect.
result.loop_termination: Voluntary; requires the stated opponent-decline condition to hold on every iteration, and (for the accumulating-mana case) at least 3 opponents.

rules_citations: CR 707.2 - a copy acquires the copiable characteristics (including rules text) of the original, so Clever Impersonator functions as a genuine second Smothering Tithe.
CR 603.2c - each object's own triggered ability triggers independently on a matching event; two separate Tithe-bearing permanents each trigger once on the same draw.
CR 605 - Treasure's '{T}, Sacrifice: Add one mana of any color' is a mana ability.
